thread:
Priya: Heads-up — AP paid AIModels Ltd invoice #AI-2026-451 today but withheld 30% because there was no W-8 on file. Vendor is now asking for a gross-up to cover the withheld amount. Invoice USD 10,000, withheld = USD 3,000. PO 12321. PDF: https://invoices.example.com/AI-2026-451.pdf

Sam: We generally don’t gross-up vendor withholding unless contract explicitly requires it. Can you confirm if the vendor's contract has any tax gross-up clause?

Elena: Contract review: section 6.2 says "vendor bears taxes unless otherwise agreed in writing." No gross-up clause. Two things matter: (a) effective date on W-8BEN-E, (b) whether AP has remitted withheld funds to IRS. If W-8 was valid as of invoice/payment date we can reverse withholding and pay gross. If funds already remitted, refund path is more complicated.

Priya: AP note: remittance scheduled for 2026-04-01 (still pending). Vendor uploaded a W-8BEN-E just now, signed 2026-02-15, shows chapter 3 status = beneficial owner claiming treaty benefit = N/A. I'll attach Coupa doc screenshot.

Jorge: Hi! Sorry for the gap. We uploaded the W-8 earlier but maybe under our old legal name. We're happy to accept net payment or have you reverse the withholding. Gross-up would be ideal for us but we understand company policy. Happy to provide any supporting docs. :pray:

Sam: Practical path: 1) Pause remittance immediately (Priya/AP). 2) Tax to validate W-8 fields (legal name match, foreign TIN). 3) If valid and effective before payment date, release full invoice amount to vendor and cancel withholding. 4) If remittance already sent, vendor usually must claim refund from IRS (Form 843 or amended return) — we don't proactively gross-up in that case.

Elena: Also note we need to record the change in G/L and attach the W-8 to vendor master. For future onboarding, update AP checklist: require W-8 on file before first payment and include a clause that no gross-ups will be provided for vendor tax documentation failures.

tax-bot: Event: withholding_remit scheduled (status=pending, remittance_date=2026-04-01)

Priya: I put a hold on the remittance queue and tagged AP. @Sam @Elena please confirm when you validate W-8 so I can release net payment.

Jorge: Thanks — we can accept a net payment. If you confirm hold release timeline Ill cancel any internal reminders to chase the payment.

Sam: I'll validate name/TIN match vs. vendor record and confirm within the hour. If all good, AP to stop remittance and issue payment for USD 10,000. No gross-up. Closing note: vendor refunds for remitted withholding are vendor responsibility if remittance posts.

Priya: Confirmed — AP paused. Will update once payment goes out. Thanks everyone.
